lead: Gritty military sci-fi film still, mud, smoke and olive drab, teal light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for tile-mechs.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen tile-mechs-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish tile-mechs-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: type-3
images.prompt: A giant humanoid war robot's armored hand with thumb and fingers, gripping a rifle, in a hangar.

images.name: base
images.prompt: A huge armed flying warship carrier hovering over the sea, a hangar door open in its side.

images.name: job
images.prompt: A grim concrete military fortress on a hill, tanks parked below, searchlights in the dusk.

images.name: battlezone
images.prompt: A battlefield of grass, roads and fuel tanks, tanks rolling in, smoke rising.

images.name: territory
images.prompt: A military map table with a territory divided into regions, under a lamp.

images.name: press
images.prompt: A stack of newspapers fresh off the press, a photo of a giant robot in smoke on the front page.

images.name: flow
images.prompt: A giant robot kneeling in a repair bay at night, mechanics working on its legs.

images.name: props
images.prompt: A row of round fuel tanks at a military depot exploding one after another.

images.name: floor
images.prompt: A heavy weapon lying in the mud beside a burning tank wreck.

images.name: sprites
images.prompt: Rows of small toy soldiers, tanks and robots lined up on a tabletop grid.
